tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Specific experience of the Agency related to the Task

Service Provider firm should have satisfactorily completed Demolition of Buildings & Encroachment Removals of city in Bengaluru In support of this, the Service Provider shall furnish a Certificate duly certified by Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer or any Private Building
Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the TOR
Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff & supporting for the Task.
Suitability of transfer of Knowledge program (Training)

Availability by owning at least 50% of the following Key and Critical Equipment for this Work and the remaining 50% can be deployed on Lease / Hire Basis for all Works provided the Relevant Documents (Purchase Invoice in case of owning, Commitment Agreement in case of Lease or Hire Basis for Availability for this Work are furnished, Backhoe loader 1m3 Busket capcity 1.00 Own or Lease, Tipper 5.5 m3 1.00 Own or Lease, Gas or Electric welder 1.00 Own or Lease, Concrete cutting machine 1.00 Own or Lease

Service Provider firm should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.66.00 Lakhs. Further, the Financial Turnover of the Previous Years shall be given a Weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the Price Level of 2025-26. In support of this, the Service Provider shall furnish the Certificate from Chartered Accountant along with the Technical Proposal.
